opening.argument: The video centers on a discussion of the Stellar and MoneyGram partnership, including how wallets on the Stellar blockchain can move between fiat and a digital asset. A separate segment encourages viewers to order a hardware wallet through disclosed affiliate links offering a stated discount. That promotion is distinct from the partnership discussion and is not connected in the available evidence to an investment solicitation. The material does not establish deceptive conduct or transaction outcomes, nor does it independently verify the claim that ordering the wallet will keep viewers' crypto safe.
